async def act(page):
    """
    From the current New Product form state, set up the simple product as requested:
      - Name: Energy-Bulk Women Shirt
      - Price: 60
      - Status: Enabled
      - Visibility: Catalog (or Catalog, Search)
      - Inventory Qty: 50 (In Stock)
      - Size: S
      - Color: Blue
    Then click Save as the final action (it navigates away).

    Notes: No knowledge-base helper functions are available (none provided). All interactions
    use accessibility-role selectors (get_by_role / select_option) and avoid following
    navigation after clicking Save.
    """
    import asyncio

    async def safe(coro):
        try:
            return await coro
        except Exception:
            return None

    # Knowledge-base functions: none are available in the environment; thus none are used.

    # 1) Ensure General section visible and set the product Name.
    # Clicking the section link is a local UI action (does not navigate away from admin index).
    await safe(page.get_by_role("link", name="General").click())
    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    # Try exact name then fuzzy fallback
    await safe(page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Name *").fill("Energy-Bulk Women Shirt"))
    await safe(page.get_by_role("textbox", name=lambda n: n and "name" in n.lower()).fill("Energy-Bulk Women Shirt"))

    # 2) Set Status -> Enabled (combobox)
    await safe(page.get_by_role("combobox", name=lambda n: n and "status" in n.lower()).select_option(label="Enabled"))

    # 3) Set Visibility -> choose option that contains 'catalog'
    await safe(page.get_by_role("combobox", name=lambda n: n and "visibility" in n.lower()).select_option(label=lambda lbl: lbl and "catalog" in lbl.lower()))

    # 4) Open Prices section and set Price to 60. Prefer the table->row->textbox path for Price.
    await safe(page.get_by_role("link", name="Prices").click())
    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
    try:
        price_row = page.get_by_role("table").get_by_role("row", name=lambda n: n and "price" in n.lower())
        await safe(price_row.get_by_role("textbox", name=lambda n: n and "price" in n.lower()).fill("60"))
    except Exception:
        await safe(page.get_by_role("textbox", name=lambda n: n and "price" in n.lower()).fill("60"))

    # 5) Open Inventory section and set Qty to 50 and Stock Availability to In Stock.
    await safe(page.get_by_role("link", name="Inventory").click())
    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    # Quantity: try spinbutton, then textbox, then labeled fallback
    qty_set = False
    if await safe(page.get_by_role("spinbutton", name=lambda n: n and ("qty" in n.lower() or "quantity" in n.lower())).fill("50")) is not None:
        qty_set = True
    if not qty_set:
        if await safe(page.get_by_role("textbox", name=lambda n: n and ("qty" in n.lower() or "quantity" in n.lower())).fill("50")) is not None:
            qty_set = True
    if not qty_set:
        await safe(page.get_by_role("spinbutton").filter(has=page.get_by_role("label", name=lambda l: l and ("qty" in l.lower() or "quantity" in l.lower()))).fill("50"))

    # Stock Availability: try combobox option then checkbox fallback
    stock_ok = False
    if await safe(page.get_by_role("combobox", name=lambda n: n and ("stock" in n.lower() or "availability" in n.lower())).select_option(label=lambda lbl: lbl and "in stock" in lbl.lower())) is not None:
        stock_ok = True
    if not stock_ok:
        if await safe(page.get_by_role("combobox").filter(has=page.get_by_role("label", name=lambda l: l and ("stock" in l.lower() or "availability" in l.lower()))).select_option(label=lambda lbl: lbl and "in stock" in lbl.lower())) is not None:
            stock_ok = True
    if not stock_ok:
        await safe(page.get_by_role("checkbox", name=lambda n: n and "in stock" in n.lower()).check())

    # 6) Select Size = S and Color = Blue (attribute comboboxs)
    await safe(page.get_by_role("combobox", name=lambda n: n and "size" in n.lower()).select_option(label=lambda lbl: lbl and lbl.strip().lower() == "s"))
    await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    await safe(page.get_by_role("combobox", name=lambda n: n and "color" in n.lower()).select_option(label=lambda lbl: lbl and "blue" in lbl.lower()))

    # 7) Final action: click Save (navigates away) - must be last
    # Prefer exact top-level Save button name, fallback to any button/link containing 'save'
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    except Exception:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name=lambda n: n and "save" in n.lower()).click()
        except Exception:
            await safe(page.get_by_role("link", name=lambda n: n and "save" in n.lower()).click())

    # wait for save/navigation to complete
    try:
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    except Exception:
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
